case_title: MUNZER DAJANI ET AL VS. SOCIETE AIR FRANCE

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $9,960.00 FILED BY DAJANI, MUNZER AROUS, SAOUSAN DAJANI, DANYA DAJANI, RAMA AS TO DEFENDANT SOCIETE AIR FRANCE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-02-2023 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-02-2023 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF DEFENDANT TO JUN-01-2023 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF MUNZER DAJANI IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF SAOUSAN AROUS IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF RAMA DAJANI IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF DANYA DAJANI IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT SOCIETE AIR FRANCE IS PRESENT VIA UNAUTHORIZED ZOOM APPEARANCE REPRESENTED BY LILA TAHIDOCSTI, LEGAL TRAINING. SHOULD THE DEFENDANT WANT TO APPEAR BY ZOOM AT THE NEXT HEARING, THE COURT REQUIRES AN APPROVED ZOOM APPEARANCE PACKET 10 DAYS PRIOR TO THE NEXT HEARING AND EXHIBITS SENT TO THE COURT AND THE PLAINTIFFS. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: PANG LY; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER TO CONTINUE PER REQUEST OF DEFENDANT.

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUN-01-2023 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUN-01-2023 BY JUDGE GARRETT L. WONG. PLAINTIFF MUNZER DAJANI IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF SAOUSAN AROUS IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF RAMA DAJANI IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF DANYA DAJANI IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT SOCIETE AIR FRANCE IS PRESENT VIA UNAUTHORIZED ZOOM APPEARANCE REPRESENTED BY LILA TAHIDOCSTI, LEGAL TRAINEE. COURT GRANTS DEFENDANT ZOOM APPEARANCE FOR TODAY'S HEARING. DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: GARRETT L WONG; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) LILA TAHIDOUSTI, LEGAL TRAINEE. FILED BY DEFENDANT SOCIETE AIR FRANCE
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-01-2023 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF DAJANI, MUNZER AROUS, SAOUSAN DAJANI, DANYA DAJANI, RAMA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT SOCIETE AIR FRANCE $4,210.00 PRINCIPAL, $90.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $4,300.00, THE $4,210.00 AWARD CONSISTS OF EXPENSES INCURED BY PLAINTIFFS ($2,410.00) AND COMPENSATION TO THREE(3) PASSENGERS UNDER E.U. RULE 261/2004 @$600 EACH FOR THE SUM OF $1,800.00. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
